newsitem.title: UK: UK taxman to ignore Halifax free shares - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK taxman to ignore Halifax free shares - paper.

text.p: The Inland Revenue has decided no member of the Halifax or any other converting British building society need pay tax on their share bonuses, the Daily Telegraph reported on Friday.
The ruling shields a potential 20 billion pounds ($33.77 billion) of shares from the taxman this year.
The newspaper said investors who received free share bonuses from converting societies could legally exceed annual personal equity plan limits with the blessing of the taxman.
The Halifax has said it plans to release on Friday details of the build-up to its transfer, including the need for half of its qualifying members to vote for conversion. ($1=.5922 Pound)
